title: Cloud Security Basics
subtitle: Shared responsibility, identity, data, platform, logging, and audit foundations
description: Ten 2020–2021 episodes explaining how provider protections and customer controls fit together: identity, data access, hardware, service accounts, security logging, and audit trails.

title: Getting Started with Cloud Security Command Center
subtitle: Five historical walkthroughs of scanning, detection, data protection, and security posture
description: Five 2019 walkthroughs show how vulnerability scans, anomalous activity, sensitive-data findings, and configuration checks lead to investigation and remediation. A finding signals something to investigate, not proof of a breach.

title: Serverless Expeditions — selected guide
subtitle: Fourteen episodes on service choice, architecture, scaling, state, security, operations, and delivery
description: Serverless design and operations through concrete examples: choosing a runtime, ordering events, managing relational state, undoing failed workflows, protecting secrets, and deploying changes safely. The selection also includes two AI-agent examples covering tools and database access.

title: Pub/Sub Made Easy
subtitle: A ten-episode progression through topics, subscriptions, clients, endpoints, and replay
description: Ten 2019–2020 episodes follow a message from publication to independent subscription backlogs, delivery, acknowledgement, and replay. Examples compare push and pull consumers and connect them to serverless endpoints.

title: Pub/Sub Best Practices
subtitle: Publishing, subscribing, feature, latency, client-library, and testing trade-offs
description: Six 2023 episodes explain Pub/Sub trade-offs in batching, retries, ordering, flow control, retention, regional placement, and testing. Recommendations reflect the client libraries and service behavior discussed in that series.

title: Google Cloud Essentials — selected guide
subtitle: Eight concise orientations to compute, storage, containers, projects, delivery, logs, and errors
description: Eight 2020–2022 explainers introduce compute, storage, containers, Firebase projects, build tools, logging, and error reporting through the workloads each service supports.

title: Engineering for Reliability
subtitle: Twenty-three substantive episodes on SLOs, telemetry, alerting, investigation, and operations
description: Twenty-three 2021–2022 episodes connect user-facing reliability targets to metrics, logs, traces, and alerts. Examples show instrumentation, Prometheus collection, quota monitoring, GKE investigation, and observability cost controls.

title: Get Started with Google Cloud — selected guide
subtitle: Twelve practical entries spanning docs, networking, storage, IAM, cost, data, workflows, and APIs
description: Twelve 2018–2022 introductions use small tasks to explain networking, persistent storage, access control, BigQuery queries and cost limits, object versions, sensitive-data inspection, workflow orchestration, and speech transcription.

title: Build With Google Cloud
subtitle: Five 2022 architecture snapshots for banking, commerce, edge, and social applications
description: Five 2022 presentations explore banking, e-commerce, restaurant-edge, and photo-sharing systems. Proposed architectures and demonstrations connect application requirements to service boundaries, data flows, and deployment choices.

title: Cloud Bytes — selected guide
subtitle: Twelve one-minute orientations across compute, data, operations, networking, and security
description: Twelve short primers introduce the roles of Google Cloud compute, storage, databases, messaging, analytics, observability, networking, and access controls. These 2020–2022 overviews help orient service choices rather than provide deployment recipes.

title: Beyond Your Bill — selected guide
subtitle: Eleven episodes on resource ownership, billing analysis, budgets, commitments, and GKE efficiency
description: Eleven 2019–2021 episodes explain who owns cloud spending, how to analyze it, and where commitments and GKE sizing can reduce waste. Budget alerts notify teams; they do not impose a spending cap.

title: Architecting with Google Cloud — selected guide
subtitle: Ten case studies on scale, service boundaries, data platforms, machine learning, and security
description: Ten 2021–2023 case studies explain how teams handle global storage, concurrent requests, service boundaries, media ingestion, analytics migration, machine learning, healthcare data, and security response. Results describe the participating organizations' systems, not universal performance guarantees.

title: Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework
subtitle: Six pillars for reviewing cloud architecture and operations
description: A six-pillar review framework for designing and operating secure, reliable, efficient, high-performing, cost-effective, and sustainable cloud workloads.

title: Enterprise foundations blueprint
subtitle: A Terraform-backed baseline for enterprise governance and security
description: Google's reference foundation for consistent resource hierarchy, identity, networking, logging, policy, secrets, keys, and threat detection at enterprise scale.

title: Professional Network Engineer Certification
subtitle: A sixteen-activity learning path for Google Cloud networking
description: A practical learning path spanning Google Cloud networking fundamentals, routing, load balancing, security, architecture, hybrid connectivity, observability, GKE, and skill-badge labs.

title: Configure Workload Identity Federation with deployment pipelines
subtitle: Keyless authentication from external CI/CD systems to Google Cloud
description: A practical guide to exchanging deployment-platform OIDC tokens for short-lived Google Cloud credentials with explicit admission and IAM controls.

title: Best practices for using Workload Identity Federation
subtitle: Trust, least-privilege, and audit controls for external workloads
description: Google's security guidance for hardening federated workload trust against spoofing, privilege escalation, weak audit trails, and malicious credential configurations.
